name: grimmsnarl_ml_v10
policy: grimmsnarl_ml_v8 unchanged, plus one residual class: a dead Unfair Stamp taken out of a Petrel search is replaced when three of four re-pinned pilots agree on the same alternative.

residual.board_condition: the opponent took no prize during their last turn, and no Unfair Stamp is already in hand
residual.note: The panel is the shipped model scored as four other pilots. teacher_team_id is a categorical input, so a second opinion costs one tree pass and no extra artifact.

not_implemented.petrel_boss: Taking Boss's Orders out of a Petrel search runs *with* pilot rating (rho +0.5805, p 0.00579) and v8 takes it on 0 of 64 offers, but every panel pilot is also near zero on v8's boards (0.016-0.109), so there is no consensus to gate on. Recorded as the next candidate.
not_implemented.alakazam_matchup: The premise this version was commissioned on does not survive its own test: the Alakazam family is 4-7 at Fisher p 0.18, and 0-5 against 4-7 for everything else once turn order and opponent rating are matched (p 0.24). No repeated, multiply-supported shape exists on those boards.

description: A residual over the frozen v8, not a new policy. It changes 5 decisions in 50 stored games and leaves every measured resource rate bit-identical.
